protocol: Read-only source, saved trajectories and train-domain checks; no new API calls or fitting
retrieval_policy: Frozen audited pool; query reranking cannot fetch new papers.

declared_regime.proxy_assumptions: Assumes adsorbates are rigid and treated at infinite dilution where adsorbate-adsorbate rotational correlations vanish; assumes PMI ordering (PMI1 smallest) is consistent across the dataset; source conditions may differ from pure-silica rigid frameworks, so transfer is hypothesized, not established.
declared_regime.physical_interpretation: PMI1*PMI2*PMI3 measures overall rotational inertia; q-normalization removes unit-scale dependence of the log; PBF measures deviation from planarity (not minimum diameter), so a large PBF means a 3D molecule with more allowed orientations in wide pores.

declared_regime.proxy_assumptions: Assumes lsd_p (largest free-sphere path) is a valid geometric proxy for the confining dimension relevant to configurational entropy at infinite dilution; assumes GeDi reflects the molecular dimension governing fit (it is the largest interatomic distance, an upper bound on molecular length); threshold lsd_p/GeDi near 1 is a q-ref-normalized comparison, not proof of physical equality of length scales.
declared_regime.physical_interpretation: lsd_p is a pure framework geometry (Å); GeDi measures molecular elongation (Å); the ratio is a dimensionless fit index where smaller values indicate tighter geometric matching and hence stronger confinement; q_density only encodes the published framework-density scale without unit assignment.

declared_regime.proxy_assumptions: PMI ratio proxies shape anisotropy of the gas-phase geometry, assumed to transfer to the adsorbed state; lsd_p/lsd_f proxies path dimensionality; rigid pure-silica frameworks at infinite dilution assumed.
declared_regime.physical_interpretation: PMI1 and PMI3 are principal moments of inertia in angstrom^2*amu; their q-ratio crossing one reflects relative anisotropy against the training median, not a physical isotropy threshold.

declared_regime.proxy_assumptions: Gas-phase principal moments and GeDi are assumed representative of the adsorbed geometry (no conformational change on adsorption); GeDi/lsd_f is a fit proxy, not a literal insertion criterion; rigid pure-silica frameworks at infinite dilution assumed.
declared_regime.physical_interpretation: PMI3/PMI1 is a dimensionless anisotropy ratio of independently median-normalized moments; GeDi and lsd_f are both lengths so q_GeDi/q_lsd_f is dimensionless, but unity of neither ratio implies physical equality between the underlying quantities.

declared_regime.proxy_assumptions: Gas-phase geometry is assumed representative of the adsorbed state (no conformational change); GeDi/SPAN is treated as a pure shape-elongation proxy, not a literal insertion criterion; rigid pure-silica frameworks at infinite dilution assumed.
declared_regime.physical_interpretation: GeDi and SPAN are both molecular lengths in angstrom; the q-ratio uses independent median references, so a value of one does not imply GeDi equals SPAN, and elongation near one is a training-median-relative shape statement, not an absolute isotropy threshold.

declared_regime.proxy_assumptions: Assumes adsorbates are rigid, near-free rotors in the gas phase and orientationally confined in pores; PBF is treated as an out-of-plane thickness proxy (not a minimum diameter); PMI ordering is not assumed, so the anisotropy term is taken as an absolute log-ratio. Proxy consistency check only; association may be confounded.
declared_regime.physical_interpretation: q_PBF is a median-normalized thickness index; abs(log(q_PMI2/q_PMI1)) is a dimensionless anisotropy magnitude whose value of zero means median-normalized PMI2 equals median-normalized PMI1, not physical equality of the moments.

declared_regime.proxy_assumptions: Assumes rigid adsorbates that are near-free rotors in the gas phase and orientationally confined in pores; PBF is used as an out-of-plane thickness proxy only (not a molecular diameter); PMI ordering (PMI3 largest) is a property of real molecules, so no absolute value is needed. Rigid pure-silica frameworks at infinite dilution assumed; source conditions may differ. Proxy consistency check only, not causal validation.
declared_regime.physical_interpretation: q_PBF is a median-normalized thickness index; q_PMI1/q_PMI3 is a dimensionless anisotropy ratio bounded above by ~1 for physically valid moments, but a value of 1 means both moments equal their own medians, not that the molecule is a spherical top.

declared_regime.proxy_assumptions: MW is used as a proxy for gas-phase translational entropy via the Sackur-Tetrode mass scaling at fixed T; q_AV (accessible volume per framework mass, median-normalized) is used as a proxy for occupiable volume. AV is probe-defined (specific volume per mass), so q_AV/q_MW = 1 carries no physical equality meaning; only the monotone association is tested. Transfer from aluminosilicate experimental data to pure-silica rigid frameworks at infinite dilution is assumed, not established.
declared_regime.physical_interpretation: q_MW rises with adsorbate mass (larger translational entropy to lose); q_AV rises with framework openness (less confinement). The log-difference is a dimensionless confinement index; its scale is median-normalized and threshold-free.

declared_regime.proxy_assumptions: PMI3 is used as a proxy for gas-phase rotational entropy (the rotor entropy grows with the geometric mean of moments; PMI3 is its largest component). lsd_f/lsd_p is a dimensionless geometry ratio proxying cage-vs-window confinement; a value of one does not mean cage equals window physically. No rotational symmetry number or temperature is available, so only monotone trends are testable.
declared_regime.physical_interpretation: q_PMI3 measures rotational inertia of the adsorbate relative to the median adsorbate; lsd_f/lsd_p measures how much the largest cavity exceeds the diffusing bottleneck. Their product (in log form) estimates the degree to which an inertial rotor is trapped in cage-window geometry. Pure-silica rigid-framework, infinite-dilution transfer is assumed.

declared_regime.proxy_assumptions: GeDi proxies the rotational lever arm; it is a maximum interatomic distance, not a rotor diameter. lsd_f/lsd_p is a geometric ratio from probe spheres; its value of one does not mean cavity equals window physically. Transfer from aluminosilicate experiments to rigid pure-silica frameworks at infinite dilution is assumed, not established. Only monotone associations are testable (no symmetry numbers or temperature available).
declared_regime.physical_interpretation: q_GeDi rises with molecular elongation (larger rotational inertia scale); lsd_f/lsd_p rises with cage-window mismatch (more trapping per unit elongation). The log-difference is a dimensionless trapping index; no q-threshold is interpreted as physical equality of GeDi and any pore length.

declared_regime.proxy_assumptions: PMI3 (largest principal moment, units angstrom^2*amu) and SPAN (angstrom, radius about center of mass) enter only through their median-normalized q-forms, so q_PMI3 / q_SPAN^2 is dimensionless and unit-consistent; the ratio of two independently normalized quantities carries no physical equality meaning at value one. No symmetry number or temperature is available, so only monotone trends are testable. SPAN is a radius of the whole molecule, not a rotor diameter, and PBF is planarity, not a minimum diameter; this index is a shape proxy only.
declared_regime.physical_interpretation: At fixed overall size (q_SPAN), a larger q_PMI3 means mass concentrated away from the center of mass (planar/hollow/elongated geometry), implying stronger rotational restriction when the molecule sits at a pore wall. The index is a dimensionless shape signature; its scale is median-normalized and threshold-free.

declared_regime.proxy_assumptions: Rigid, symmetric-top-agnostic molecules; symmetry number and temperature are not available inputs, so the descriptor is a proxy for S_rot/R up to an unknown additive constant that the network absorbs. Rotationally frozen internal modes are ignored. Source evidence is aluminosilicate hydrocarbon data; transfer to pure silica assumes F_rot depends on pore geometry, not framework composition.
declared_regime.physical_interpretation: PMI1 < PMI2 < PMI3 typically; the product measures overall rotational inertia. q-thresholds of 1 are medians, not physical identity to any reference molecule.

declared_regime.proxy_assumptions: GeDi is the largest molecular atom distance, used as a length-scale proxy for the molecule's channel-navigating extent; PBF planarity is deliberately not used as a diameter. lsd_p and GeDi are median-normalized independently, so a ratio of 1 is not physical equality of aperture and molecule. Transfer assumes rigid pure-silica frameworks at infinite dilution, whereas source data include cationic frameworks and finite loading.
declared_regime.physical_interpretation: Large positive log ratio: open channels relative to molecule length, weaker confinement; negative: molecule extent comparable to path sphere, strong gating. Thresholds are median artifacts only.

declared_regime.proxy_assumptions: PBF (mean atom distance from best-fit plane) is used as a proxy for out-of-plane thickness, a shape descriptor, not a minimum diameter. Assumes PBF correlates with the asymmetric-top rotational partition function contribution in a direction the network can exploit. Transfer from aluminosilicate to pure silica assumes shape-entropy coupling is framework-chemistry independent at fixed geometry.
declared_regime.physical_interpretation: Higher PBF means more 3D (globular) molecular shape; q_PBF > 1 means thicker than median. The product with q_Vol/q_AV scales shape-globularity with confinement severity; ratios near 1 are median artifacts.

declared_regime.proxy_assumptions: MW is used as a proxy for gas-phase translational entropy (Sackur–Tetrode mass^(3/2) scaling) at the implicit evaluation temperature; internal vibrational entropy differences are ignored. AV (cm^3/g) and Vol (angstrom^3) and lsd_f (angstrom) are independently median-normalized, so the combined ratio is a dimensionless confinement-severity index, not a physical volume equality. Transfer from aluminosilicate hydrocarbon data to pure-silica infinite-dilution systems assumes the translational entropy-loss mechanism depends on geometry, not framework composition.
declared_regime.physical_interpretation: Large q_MW means a heavy molecule with more translational entropy to lose; large q_Vol/(q_AV*q_lsd_f) means a bulky molecule in a lean, small-pore framework. Thresholds of 1 are median artifacts, not physical equalities of mass, volume, or length.

declared_regime.proxy_assumptions: lsd_f/lsd_p ratio proxies cage-versus-channel topology: large ratio means large isolated cages connected through narrow windows; AV proxies total accessible voidage. AV (cm^3/g), lsd_f and lsd_p (angstrom) are independently median-normalized so the descriptor is a dimensionless topology index, not a physical clearance ratio. Assumes cage-trapping at infinite dilution transfers from the pure-silica MCM-22 case to other pure-silica frameworks, and that probe-based AV reflects voidage relevant to the adsorbates studied.
declared_regime.physical_interpretation: High descriptor: cage-like, poorly connected, low-voidage framework hosting a bulky molecule, so trapped configurations with restricted rotation dominate; low descriptor: open connected channels, weaker entropy loss. Thresholds of 1 are median artifacts, not physical equalities.

declared_regime.proxy_assumptions: lsd_p/lsd_f proxies pore connectivity/tortuosity of confinement; GeDi proxies molecular longest axis, not a fitted critical diameter. Pure-silica rigid frameworks at infinite dilution assumed; source evidence spans aluminosilicates and finite loadings, so transfer is a hypothesis. q_GeDi=1 does not imply geometric equality with the reference molecule.
declared_regime.physical_interpretation: lsd_p/lsd_f near 1 means channel-like (path ≈ free sphere) frameworks; dividing by q_GeDi measures free passage relative to molecular span in native length units.

declared_regime.proxy_assumptions: PMI product proxies gas-phase rotational entropy magnitude (rigid rotor, symmetric-number effects ignored); lsd_f/lsd_p in (0,1] proxies rotational hindrance. lsd_f/lsd_p is dimensionless so the log argument is dimensionless. Transfer from aluminosilicate finite-loading data to pure-silica infinite dilution is assumed, not established.
declared_regime.physical_interpretation: Larger geometric-mean moment of inertia means more gas-phase rotational entropy available to lose; smaller lsd_f/lsd_p means more obstructed rotation, amplifying the loss.

declared_regime.proxy_assumptions: PBF proxies out-of-plane bulkiness (not a minimum diameter); q_AV is a dimensionless normalization of specific accessible volume per framework mass and is NOT molecular free volume — AV/Vol without mass normalization is avoided. The q-ratio value 1 does not mean physical equality of PBF and AV scales; only monotone ordering is claimed. Transfer to pure-silica infinite dilution from mixed-framework evidence is a hypothesis.
declared_regime.physical_interpretation: q_PBF rises for three-dimensionally bulky molecules that cannot lie flat against pore walls; q_AV falls for tightly confined frameworks; their ratio is large when rotational restriction (and hence entropy loss) should be greatest.

declared_regime.proxy_assumptions: Vol proxies molecular bulk relevant to confinement, not molecular free volume; AV is specific accessible volume per framework mass (cm^3/g) and is NOT divided by Vol because no mass-normalization model exists. q_Vol and q_AV are independently median-normalized; a q-ratio of 1 does not imply physical equality of volume scales. Source evidence is aluminosilicate, finite-loading hydrocarbon data; transfer to pure-silica infinite dilution is a hypothesis, not established.
declared_regime.physical_interpretation: log(q_Vol)>0 for molecules larger than the training-median molecule (more gas-phase entropy available to lose, scaling logarithmically with mass/volume); dividing by q_AV discounts this where the framework offers more pore volume per mass, i.e., weaker confinement. The descriptor is largest for bulky molecules in low-AV frameworks.

declared_regime.proxy_assumptions: The PMI product proxies gas-phase rotational entropy magnitude (rigid rotor; symmetry-number and temperature dependence ignored, absorbed by the network). q_lsd_f is a dimensionless confinement proxy: small values indicate tight cages. q_PMI values near 1 do not mean physical equality with the median molecule. Source evidence spans aluminosilicates and finite loadings; transfer to pure-silica infinite dilution is an assumption.
declared_regime.physical_interpretation: Large geometric-mean moment of inertia means more rotational entropy available to lose; small largest free-sphere diameter means rotational modes are obstructed, so their product proxies rotational entropy loss. Dividing by q_lsd_f (rather than a geometric ratio) keeps the descriptor smooth and strictly monotone in each factor.

declared_regime.proxy_assumptions: LabuteASA proxies molecular contact area with walls; framework ASA (m^2/g) and LabuteASA (angstrom^2) have different native units, so only their independently median-normalized q-forms are combined — a q-ratio of 1 does not mean physical area equality. lsd_p proxies bottleneck connectivity along diffusion paths. q_lsd_p bounded away from zero by its positive reference. Transfer from aluminosilicate/finite-loading evidence to pure-silica infinite dilution is a hypothesis.
declared_regime.physical_interpretation: Large molecular surface and small framework-accessible area per mass with narrow paths imply strong molecule–wall contact and restricted passage, so entropy loss should be largest. The descriptor is smallest for small molecules in open, well-connected frameworks.

declared_regime.proxy_assumptions: PMI3/PMI1 proxies rotor asphericity, not a direct measure of lost rotational freedom; symmetry numbers and internal rotations are not captured; density is used only as reference-normalized q_density because its physical unit is unresolved; lsd_f is a proxy cavity diameter; adsorbate treated as rigid monomer at infinite dilution.
declared_regime.physical_interpretation: PMI3/PMI1 is a dimensionless shape ratio; the denominator is a composite of two independently median-normalized framework terms, so descriptor value 1 carries no physical equality meaning.

declared_regime.proxy_assumptions: lsd_f proxies cavity confinement diameter (it is a free-sphere diameter, not the average cavity diameter used in the source); GeDi proxies effective molecular size for rotation. q-ratio = 1 does not imply lsd_f equals GeDi physically because references are independent medians. Transfer from aluminosilicate hydrocarbon data to pure-silica rigid frameworks at infinite dilution is assumed, not established.
declared_regime.physical_interpretation: Descriptor is a dimensionless geometric confinement index; larger values mean more room for the molecule relative to the pore throat, hence weaker restriction of helicopter/cartwheel rotations.

declared_regime.proxy_assumptions: Geometric mean PMI proxies isotropic rotational inertia; lsd_f**2 proxies the free area available for rotation; PMI carries a mass factor so the ratio is a proxy, not a pure length ratio; lsd_f is a cage/channel diameter proxy, not a measured cavity dimension, and q-ratio thresholds are not physical equalities.
declared_regime.physical_interpretation: Native PMI1-3 quantify how mass is distributed about the molecule; native lsd_f quantifies the widest sphere the framework admits. Their normalized mismatch proxies how strongly helicopter/cartwheel rotations are hindered.

declared_regime.proxy_assumptions: GeDi/PBF proxies molecular elongation (PBF is planarity thickness, not minimum diameter); lsd_p proxies the narrowest passage the molecule must rotate within; q_density carries only the source numerical scale, no assigned physical unit; the product of independently normalized q-ratios is dimensionless but its value 1 has no physical equality meaning.
declared_regime.physical_interpretation: Native GeDi measures molecular end-to-end extent, PBF the out-of-plane thickness, lsd_p the free-sphere path diameter, and density the framework packing on the source scale. The descriptor measures steric locking of elongated molecules inside narrow, densely packed pore networks.

declared_regime.proxy_assumptions: Vol**(1/3) proxies molecular size; sqrt(ASA) proxies a linear dimension of the accessible wall network per framework mass; both q-terms are independently median-normalized so the ratio value 1 carries no physical equality meaning. ASA is probe-accessible area per framework mass, not the true adsorption-site surface.
declared_regime.physical_interpretation: Native Vol is the adsorbate van der Waals volume; native ASA is the probe-accessible framework surface area per gram. The descriptor measures how much wall area exists relative to the molecule size, proxying the number of accessible translational configurations.

declared_regime.proxy_assumptions: PMI3/PMI1 is a dimensionless anisotropy proxy for how unequally rotational freedom can be lost about the molecular axes; Vol**(1/3) proxies molecular size; lsd_p proxies the narrowest passage the molecule must rotate within; PMI and pore diameters are imperfect proxies for rotational freedom and cages differ from free-path diameters; q-ratio thresholds of 1 have no physical equality meaning.
declared_regime.physical_interpretation: Native PMI1 and PMI3 describe how molecular mass is distributed about the principal axes (elongated or flattened molecules have PMI3 >> PMI1); native lsd_p is the largest sphere that fits along a diffusion path. The descriptor measures how strongly shape-anisotropic molecules are rotationally locked inside narrow passages.

declared_regime.proxy_assumptions: Vol**(1/3) proxies molecular confinement length; q_AV is independently median-normalized so the ratio value 1 has no physical equality meaning; AV is specific volume per framework mass, not molecular free volume, and needs no mass normalization model here because only the ratio enters a relative comparison; the cube roots are applied to both sides so the ratio of cube roots equals the cube root of a relative-volume contrast only in a proxy sense.
declared_regime.physical_interpretation: Native Vol is the adsorbate van der Waals volume; native AV is the probe-accessible pore volume per gram of framework. The descriptor measures how little free volume the framework offers relative to the molecule's own size, proxying lost translational freedom.
